_help: One entry per card. Wrap words in **double asterisks** for the gold highlight. 'media' = file in ../media_processed. 'text_pos': 'top' | 'middle' | 'bottom' (keep faces/bodies clear). 'focus': [x, y] 0-1 point the push-in zooms toward. 'fx': 'punch' (snap zoom) | 'flash' (white flash) | 'big' (white flash + huge single-line text) pattern interrupts. 'loop': true makes the card zoom back out to match the first frame. 'durationSec' optional override (auto: 1.5-2.2s by word count, hook 2.5s). After editing, run: python3 tools/prepare_media.py, then npm run render.

cards.text: **How do you pull a bow with no arms?**
She learned to shoot with her **legs and feet**.
The **first armless woman** to win a world title.
